text: ## T06 stage-two contract recheck — FAIL **1 blocking, 0 should_fix in this recheck.** Focused91 passed **91/91** on Node `v24.22.3` with 77 metrics tests, 14 team tests, and no skips. **13 of 14** changed-case CLI controls matched. Both false rejections from Stage 15 are resolved. This was an independent Codex context using the same OpenAI provider. [Focused log](/tmp/pace-t06-r23-independent.jvjN2i/focused91.log) · [Probe results](/tmp/pace-t06-r23-independent.jvjN2i/probes/results.json) ### Blocking · T-4 · `finish` accepts HTML outside a valid link With `[범위](details.md 자료)` in the team-row summary, `project finish P001` exited **0**, expected **1**. The text after `details.md` is not a valid link title. The scanner at `destinationEnd` accepts the balanced parenthesized sequence anyway, and `cellText` discards it before `usableText` can see the HTML. The offline Markdown control produced no link. The paired input `[범위](details.md "자료")` produced a link and correctly passed `finish`. A standalone `` control correctly failed. This leaves a hole in the documented rejection of HTML presentation outside links.
